name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Lint files
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Typecheck files
        run: npm run typecheck

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          lfs: true

      - name: Setup
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Setup ccache
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-ccache
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          key: tests-${{ hashFiles('vendor/VERSIONS') }}
          max-size: 300M

      - name: Run ts unit tests
        run: npm test -- --maxWorkers=2 --coverage

      - name: Run c++ unit tests
        run: |
          cd tests
          chmod +x build_and_test.sh run_tests.sh
          ./build_and_test.sh
          ./run_tests.sh

      - name: Save ccache
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: ./.github/actions/save-ccache

  build-ios-from-source:
    runs-on: macos-26
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup
        with:
          bootstrap: metal

      # React Native itself is most of this build and only changes with the
      # example's dependencies, so this cache is not tied to the llama.cpp version.
      - name: Setup ccache
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-ccache
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          key: ios-from-source
          max-size: 1500M

      - name: Cache build & pods
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          path: |
            example/ios/Pods
            example/ios/build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pods-${{ hashFiles('example/ios/Podfile.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pods-

      - name: Upgrade CocoaPods to version 1.15.2
        run: |
          gem uninstall cocoapods --ignore-dependencies
          gem install cocoapods -v 1.15.2

      - name: Install cocoapods
        run: |
          npm run example run pods

      - name: Build example for iOS
        run: |
          npm run build:ios

      - name: Save ccache
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: ./.github/actions/save-ccache

  # Every xcframework slice compiles the whole library, so the slices are split
  # over parallel jobs: this one and build-ios-framework-slices. This job builds
  # the slice the example app runs on and proves the prebuilt path with it.
  # (All slices are packaged together by the release and sync workflows.)
  build-ios-frameworks:
    runs-on: macos-26

      - name: Checkout

      - name: Setup
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

        with:

          max-size: 1500M

      - name: Cache build & pods
        uses: actions/cache@v4

        with:
          path: |
            example/ios/Pods
            example/ios/build

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
